name: i-d-review
description: Marketplace for IETF Internet-Draft authoring, review, and working-group chairing tools

plugins.name: i-d-review
plugins.description: IETF Internet-Draft authoring, review, and working-group chairing. Covers BCP 14 normative language, citation verification, document structure, WG adoption, and bis-document scope for drafts; the chair's role in document advancement (adoption calls, WG Last Call, rough-consensus determination, shepherding, IETF Last Call); and working-group management (charter, milestones, IPR, meetings, list moderation).
